info.title: OpenHire Phase 4 UI API
info.description: Interviews, communication and dispatch. Staff routes use BFF session plus CSRF header, or service JWT. Public routes authenticate with an application receipt or a scheduling token, never an ambient session. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.
